title: CE-PINN: Conservation-Embedded Physics-Informed Neural Networks
description: A differentiable projection enforcing a derivative-dependent integral invariant, ∫(u²+μu_x²)dx, exactly in a physics-informed neural network. Reduces to a Helmholtz problem with Dirichlet data, solved by Newton iteration on the Lagrange multipliers. Includes the library (ce_pinn/), the experiment notebooks, the analysis and verification scripts (tools/), and the archived run outputs (results/) behind the accompanying paper.
